Higher powers of the cubic were proposed as a stronger residue filter. This update checks two limits and the correct replacement: unconstrained square-root witnesses exist at every finite precision on the stated odd-subgroup inputs; capping an independently lifted root can lose a valid full norm row; retaining BOTH norm components gives an exact bounded congruence once3k>t. [pcc:unverified]

Constructive unit-root correction preserves the base residue class and lifts through all powers. Actual point ordinates and explicit factor/product inverses establish the unit condition. Every colored tuple of nonzero points killed by a common odd q has a witness of degree<3k modulo the cubic power. - Twenty-five maintained laws and five symbolic applications compile; actual003 and mixed001 outputs are empty. Twenty-five named axiom probes use standard dependencies. Generic nonunit X control fails to lift at X^2 as predicted. [pcc:unverified]

- All494 hashes match, including449 older pins;24 rows retain published1eb23-row/main0179-row exact byte/parsed prefixes. Scoped statement `PCC-20261116-9142c5` remains unverified; no independently signed verdict or identity certificate. [pcc:unverified]

This is an exact representation correction, not a fast solver. Useful nonzero discovery in the joint norm/colored system, the tight-function principal-divisor/group-zero-sum bridge, original mixed-label useful yield and the complete classical subexponential prime-field ECDLP criterion remain open.
